BKK to Pattaya transfer .
Friend of mine put me in to Fun Trip , so I gave them a go .  Communication on what's app was very easy , good instructions for airport pick up all arrange 2 days before I arrived , and only took 5
Mins on what's app.

Driver was exactly where they said he would be , looking out for me with my name and flight number - again made it simple .

Driver took me straight to car, and then we headed down to Pattaya . Dropped me right at hotel wished me a happy holiday and off he went .

Faultless in every step of the process , I've used a few of these transfers in past , , but this was by far the easiest .

No problem recommending and giving 5
Stars ⭐️ .

Thank you to the Team at Fun Trip 🙏

Perfect taxi service ! On Time, good driver.
I forgot my AirPods in the car and the next day it was back in my hôtel room !
Highly recommended

Arranged an Airport Transfer from Jomtien to BKK Airport with Adam. It was very easy as he dealt with the driver and all arrangements. Driver arrived early, great vehicle with plenty of room and clean. Arrived at BKK with plenty of time for my flight. Very relaxing journey. I highly recommend this company and will be using them again for this service and possibly other services they provide as they are very professional.

Taxi was there on time lady gave me a call 1 hour before to confirm the pick up great service nice big comfy car .
Would recommend to any one who is getting picked up or dropped off at the airport.

Arranged with Adam a taxi from Suvarnabhumi straight to Jomtien very reasonably priced fair and to be honest cheapest I had in the last few ventures to Thailand, Taxi was on time and clean, tidy spacious and polite driver. Added Bonus 💥 , talking to driver on the way down to Pattaya I also found out that I could find somewhere to stay, rent motor cycles with the same Guy..!! Well recommended quick, easy and great prices. Thanks Adam 10/10 👍🏻🙏🏻🇹🇭
Quality service from top to bottom, easy to deal with and everything done as promised. Quality condo and service at the best price.  🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 …
Cant thank these enough for making my trip to pattaya easy, had a airport collection straight to the condo they organised and my rental Scotter was already at the condo waiting. Will defo use again
I have used the car service and rented a condo. Everything was good and very impressive. The service was very good. Thank you.
Great taxi service to and from the airport great price and on time would recommend 100% 🙏 …
It's a very nice place to relax and the view is very nice and clean . The service is also excellent. I love this place.

Used this company for my airport transfer and was faultless
Will use again!!
